narrative.headline: Braking is the top worry for 2018 Nissan Rogue owners
narrative.summary: Across 612 owner complaints to NHTSA, braking dominates: Service Brakes is the single most reported area at 42% of all reports, and Forward Collision Avoidance adds another 27% — together more than two-thirds of complaints. A common thread is brakes engaging on their own. Service Brakes alone is tied to 11 crashes and 15 injuries; no fires were reported in any category. Electrical System (13%), Engine (8%), and Vehicle Speed Control (6%) round out the list.
